codingToolNavigation.routingPrompt: [Coding nav] Prefer context_impact for callers/blast-radius; context_understand for where-a-feature-lives packs; context_verify for diff/test risk; context_reuse before writing helpers. Use native grep/read for exact text or when Fact tools miss. Expand full tool schemas via context_read('tool_registry') when needed.
codingToolNavigation.navigationLine: Coding tools: context_understand (goal pack) · context_impact (callers/radius) · context_reuse (candidates) · context_verify (related tests) · context_read/search/write (blocks). Prefer fact tools before broad grep when symbols are known.
codingToolNavigation.defaultNavPrompt:
[Coding Tool Navigation]
Coding tools: context_understand (goal pack) · context_impact (callers/radius) · context_reuse (candidates) · context_verify (related tests) · context_read/search/write (blocks). Prefer fact tools before broad grep when symbols are known.
Routing: symbol blast radius or callers → context_impact. Routing: unfamiliar area / goal framing → context_understand. Routing: find similar code to reuse → context_reuse. Routing: after edits, related tests / risk → context_verify. Routing: exact string / path unknown → grep/read; then re-check with fact tools.
